name: io.github.taneron/kleinanzeigen
description: Search Kleinanzeigen.de, Germany's largest classifieds site, for second-hand listings

environment_variables.name: WILLMEHR_MODE
environment_variables.description: 'full' (default) for a local install; 'public' paces requests and lowers the page and batch caps for an instance shared by several people.

environment_variables.name: KZ_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environment_variables.description: Minimum spacing between requests to kleinanzeigen.de, in milliseconds. Concurrency trips the site's bot detection, so requests are serialised.

environment_variables.name: KZ_MAX_PAGE_COUNT
environment_variables.description: Cap on result pages a single search may fetch, roughly 25 listings each.

environment_variables.name: KZ_MAX_BATCH_SIZE
environment_variables.description: Cap on listing ids per batch detail call.

environment_variables.name: TZ
environment_variables.description: Listing timestamps are printed without a timezone; set Europe/Berlin to interpret them exactly.
